class.name: GameplayAttributeValue
class.brief_description: A detached reading of one gameplay attribute.
class.description: Use the current reading for rules and presentation, such as updating a health display. Authority readings also expose the committed base. A recipient view exposes the confirmed current value for attributes that recipient can see. Call [method has_base] before using [method get_base].

method.name: get_base
method.description: Returns the committed base value, in the units chosen by the game. When [method has_base] is [code]false[/code], returns [code]0.0[/code] as a fallback.

method.name: get_current
method.description: Returns the confirmed effective value, in the units chosen by the game. The standalone authority derives this reading from the committed base.

method.name: has_base
method.description: Returns whether the reading includes the authority's base value. Recipient readings provide the confirmed current value only.
